mechanism: Duplicate gameStart resets an existing game of the same ID.
A shorter gameFull snapshot then derives the turn from stale history while retaining a newer local board.
One-shot ponder Abort can be erased by search startup and root-depth abort resets, causing 60-second waits.
Cancelled board streams can remain blocked delivering an event to an unbuffered channel.
fix: Ignore duplicate gameStart for the current game.
Ignore full-state histories shorter than movesApplied.
Context cancellation remains visible across ordinary abort resets.
Cancelled board streams can stop while their event delivery is blocked.
